parsed.explanation: Outside the secondary sodomy statute (life/10 years, actively used and intensified since 2021), trans-specific evidence dominates: Police Act s.35(c) is used specifically against trans people for up to 3 months' detention for 'suspicious' presence after dark, alongside documented police harassment, extortion, stripping, beatings and sexual assault in custody, with post-coup reports of torture/sexual violence, militarised policing and arbitrary detention. No enforceable protection or recourse exists; 50%/68% distrust/fear figures are undated and killing counts are raw without denominators, so magnitude is unresolved. Nat-kadaw visibility and 2020 poll support (74%/81%) are genuine but do not offset state-tolerated targeting with severe custody consequences.
